svg.title: Four principles
svg.desc: Emergencies first: Heart, breathing, stroke, crisis, collapse and bleeding are checked before anything else, in the words people actually type. 6 emergency categories. Grounded answers: Every reply is built from a curated library of 50 ICD-10 conditions, searched with field-weighted TF-IDF. 93.3% first match, unseen. No AI key needed: Runs fully offline. Gemini is optional and only rephrases what retrieval found; any failure falls back. 0 external calls required. Tested like production: Unit, API, browser and PostgreSQL suites run on every push; a drop in accuracy or coverage fails the build. 570 tests · 93.5% coverage.
